hxd-city-4.gathering_places: By midday people are gathered at the steps of Cathedral (10,000+ only), the fish market, the inns and taverns (district): talking, trading, and watching.
hxd-city-4.child_warnings: Children are warned about the usual things: the deep well, the strangers' road, the woods at twilight.
hxd-city-4.commoner_resentments: Commoners resent rising bread prices and merchants who claim they cannot help it.
hxd-city-4.outsider_impressions: Outsiders notice Noble Governorship's mark is on every door that matters.
hxd-city-4.unspoken_topics: Locals will not openly discuss the matter referenced as "the wound".
hxd-city-4.recent_changes: The last few seasons have run their usual course. No notable shifts in the rhythm of the place.

hxd-metropolis-0.food_culture: Rations are tight: grain & bread is substituted, and the poor eat watered stew.
hxd-metropolis-0.dawn_work: Dawn work is the search for food. Foragers leave before light, and the granary queue forms before the ovens are warm.
hxd-metropolis-0.gathering_places: By midday people are gathered at the steps of Great cathedral, the fish market, the inns and taverns (district): talking, trading, and watching.
hxd-metropolis-0.child_warnings: Children are warned about the road past sundown.
hxd-metropolis-0.commoner_resentments: Commoners resent rising bread prices and merchants who claim they cannot help it; and the council's indifference to ordinary complaints.
hxd-metropolis-0.outsider_impressions: Outsiders notice The Guard's mark is on every door that matters; frontier monster pressure is the obvious unspoken weight; several civic services run short. Visitors notice missing watch, slow service, or shuttered shops.
hxd-metropolis-0.unspoken_topics: Locals will not openly discuss the matter referenced as "the wound".
hxd-metropolis-0.recent_changes: The Migration (24 years ago) is still being felt: A newly arrived community and the old population fell into steady friction, rarely violent and never resolved; wartime pressure is the new shape of things.
